mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the triceps was most worthwhile because it completed the comparison: both muscles pull, but their attachments move the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps repeated the biceps construction, though the inspection was useful because I wasn't sure the bundles were still available.

surprise.text: I was unsure whether muscle bundles remained available, so the inspection automatically building the triceps surprised me.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the empty coverings and the front and back attachment goals explained the pairings.

continue.text: I would probably continue because seeing the parts assembled into a working elbow made their jobs easier to picture, though another similarly repetitive build might be less interesting.
